title: DCECE 2026 Bihar Polytechnic Result: Out Now BCECEB DCECE PE PMM PM #DCECE2026 #BiharPolytechnic2026 #BCECEBDCECE
intro: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Bord (BCECEB) has Officially Released Result for Online Admission in Polytechnic/ Diploma Certificate Entrance Competitive Examination Examination (DCECE-PE, PPE, PMD & PM) 2026. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to DCECE 2025 Admission. Exam Held On On May 23-24, 2026 & Result Released On June 11, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Last Date For Apply Online : 27 April 2026 (11:59 PM)
Last Date Online Payment : 27 April 2026 (11:59 PM)
Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking  / Offline Challan Fee Mode.
Polytechnic Engineer (PE):- 10th Pass Or Appear From Recognized Board.
Para Medical (PMM):- 10th Pass Or Appear From Recognized Board.

Para Medical (PM):- Pharmacy  Candidates Passed 12th with Physics, Chemistry, English, Maths/ Biology Subjects. GNM Course :- Candidates Passed 12th exam in Physics, Chemistry and Biology Subjects by Securing Minimum 40% Marks (40% for SC/ST).

Para Medical (Intermediate Level): 

																
																	Minimum Qualification: 10+2 / Intermediate Science with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English.
																	GNM Course (Only for Women): Minimum 40% marks in PCB, English subject required. SC/ST get 5% relaxation. ANM / Vocational Nursing candidates also eligible.
																	ANM Course (Only for Women): 10+2 with minimum 40% marks and English subject.
																	Other Courses: Intermediate Science with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English required.
																	Dental Courses: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English.
																	Appearing Candidates (2026): Also eligible to apply.
Minimum Qualification: 10+2 / Intermediate Science with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English.
GNM Course (Only for Women): Minimum 40% marks in PCB, English subject required. SC/ST get 5% relaxation. ANM / Vocational Nursing candidates also eligible.
ANM Course (Only for Women): 10+2 with minimum 40% marks and English subject.
Other Courses: Intermediate Science with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English required.
Dental Courses: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology & English.
Appearing Candidates (2026): Also eligible to apply.
PE Group exam is based on Secondary (10th Level) syllabus.
PM Group questions are based on Intermediate Level Science, Hindi and General Knowledge.
PMM Group exam is based on Secondary (10th Level) syllabus.
Each group carries a total of 90 questions and 450 marks.
Check the official prospectus for detailed syllabus and subject-wise topics.
Last Date for Apply Online: 27 April 2026 (11:59 PM)
Last Date Online Payment: 27 April 2026 (11:59 PM)
Application Fee: General / BC / EBC - ₹750, SC / ST / DQ - ₹480
For two subject groups: General / BC / EBC - ₹850, SC / ST / DQ - ₹530
For three subject groups: General / BC / EBC - ₹950, SC / ST / DQ - ₹630
Always check the official prospectus before submitting the application form.
DCECE 2026 is conducted for Polytechnic Engineering (PE), Para Medical (PM) and Para Medical Matric Level (PMM) courses.
Fill the form carefully according to your eligibility and selected subject group.
Keep all original documents ready for counselling and admission process.
Use only the official BCECEB website for registration, login, fee payment and admit card download.
Do not wait for the last date to complete the online form.
Total Seats: 40,000+ (Polytechnic & Paramedical courses in Bihar Govt/Private Institutes)
Govt Diploma Courses: Affordable, job-oriented in Engineering/Paramedical.
40,000+ Seats: High chance for Bihar students.
